_comment: THE GATE — php profile. php -l lint, PHPStan static analysis, composer audit SCA, gitleaks, PHPUnit coverage, semgrep php, trivy, codeql-php, zizmor. Ubuntu runners ship PHP + Composer.
name: github-ci-security-php
description: Enterprise-grade php gate: php -l lint, PHPStan static/type analysis, composer audit SCA, gitleaks secrets, PHPUnit coverage threshold, Semgrep, Trivy, CodeQL-php, zizmor.
notes: Contexts: sca, secrets, lint, static, coverage, semgrep, container, codeql, zizmor. Coverage requires xdebug/pcov on the runner — if the clover file is absent the threshold degrades to a warning (documented in the job). PHPStan runs on src/lib/app when present.
